verdict.detail: 15 products, 15 in Amazon's top 20 for the filters, 15 with their rating right

answer:
I applied all five filters (Aluminum, Adjustable, 4 Stars & Up, $25–$60, Best Sellers sort). Amazon showed each one as active. Below are the first 15 non-sponsored results in listed order. Amazon also showed sponsored copies of items 1 and 5 at the bottom, and I left those out.

1. B08M94BTYC | Lamicall Aluminum Laptop Stand for Desk for MacBook Air Pro Neo 10-17.3'' | $29.99 | 4.7 | 10.5K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08M94BTYC
2. B09Y8B81F7 | tounee Telescopic Laptop Stand, 360° Swivel Base, Height Adjustable, Gray | $54.99 | 4.7 | 4.3K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09Y8B81F7
3. B0CQR99BG2 | OMOTON LA10 360° Rotating Laptop Stand Riser, Foldable, Silver | $39.99 | 4.7 | 1.5K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CQR99BG2
4. B078W4XP77 | OMOTON Dual Vertical Desk Laptop Stand Holder, Silver | $23.99 | 4.8 | 10.6K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B078W4XP77
5. B0FJ8DCN5T | Lamicall Aluminum Laptop Stand for Desk for MacBook Neo Air Pro 10-17.3'' | $33.99 | 4.7 | 1.6K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FJ8DCN5T
6. B0D2R6NGNY | N86 360 Rotating Laptop Stand for Desk with Locking Knobs, Black | $35.99 | 4.6 | 1.8K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D2R6NGNY
7. B0F1FK6JY3 | 360° Rotatable Laptop Stand for Desk, Adjustable Height | $25.79 | 4.6 | 863 | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0F1FK6JY3
8. B0CNXDLJQ5 | UGREEN 3-Slot Vertical Laptop Stand Holder, Space Gray | $39.99 | 4.7 | 12.3K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CNXDLJQ5
9. B08R8GWBSM | OMOTON Adjustable Laptop Stand for Desk, 360° Rotating Base, up to 17", Silver | $29.99 | 4.7 | 3.4K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08R8GWBSM
10. B0BM4LD2BH | Aoviho Adjustable Foldable Aluminum Laptop Stand, 10-15.6", Purple | $32.99 | 4.7 | 1K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BM4LD2BH
11. B0BN434Q85 | YICOSUN Adjustable Laptop Cooling Stand, 2 Fans and RGB, Aluminum Alloy, Gray | $38.99 | 4.4 | 304 | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BN434Q85
12. B07YTHMM3B | Nulaxy Pull-Out Height Adjustable Laptop Stand, 22 LB Support | $44.64 | 4.7 | 8.3K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07YTHMM3B
13. B086L35VML | Laptop Stand Adjustable Portable Aluminum for 10"-17" Laptop Tablet | $30.99 | 4.6 | 2.9K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B086L35VML
14. B07RT2C23Y | HumanCentric Vertical Laptop Stand, Space Grey, MacBook Adjustable | $30.99 | 4.4 | 4.5K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07RT2C23Y
15. B074PPGHMC | OMOTON Vertical Laptop Stand Holder, Adjustable Dock for MacBook, Silver | $26.99 | 4.8 | 9.2K | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B074PPGHMC

Item 4 shows $23.99, which is under your $25 floor. Amazon listed it anyway, and its other option is $27.99. I kept it as shown.

**Recommendation: #1, the Lamicall (B08M94BTYC), $29.99.**
- **Rank and reviews:** It's the top Best Seller in this filtered set. Its 4.7 stars come from 10.5K ratings, so the rating is well backed.
- **Fit for your use:** I read its product page. It's aluminum, adjusts in height and angle, and folds flat. It fits laptops from 10" to 17.3", including MacBook Pro, and it has a large, stable base with ventilation holes.
- **Price:** At $29.99 it costs about the same as the OMOTON adjustable stand (#9, $29.99) and less than the others near it in popularity.

Several results are vertical docks (#4, #8, #14, #15). They store a closed laptop and don't raise it for typing, so they don't suit a MacBook Pro 14 you use at a desk.

I didn't check whether the Lamicall has a 14" MacBook Pro-specific fit beyond its 10–17.3" range.
